script.title: Captain Tempo Counts the Crossing
script.synopsis: At a busy junction Captain Tempo counts down THREE, TWO, ONE, AND with her whole body; the signal flips on its own timer; she erupts into the Tempo Stomp as if she caused it; a commuter walks through her celebration without a glance and the camera lingers one beat too long.

beats.beat: Wide low shot: towering teal-and-gold woman, arms raised like a conductor, red figure glowing; downbeat on THREE
Conducting arms and bounce build; the countdown is the rule stated aloud
Whistle blast on TWO, roar of ONE, push-in tightens
AND: the signal flips on its own timer; Tempo Stomp
Commuter walks through her frozen victory; camera lingers one beat too long

script.caption_text: She counted. The light changed. Obviously she did that.
script.disclosure_line: AI-generated character and footage; original character.

scenes.location: Pedestrian crossing at a busy junction, grey city street, kerb on the near side of the road, signal pole behind her
scenes.action: Wide, slightly low across the road: Captain Tempo stands at the kerb towering over a blurred grey stream of pedestrians, both arms raised like a conductor about to cue an orchestra, red standing figure glowing on the signal behind her. Her raised arms slam down on the beat as she bellows THREE and the handheld camera starts its slow push-in.
scenes.performance: Invested task: set the downbeat for the entire crossing; she stares down the blurred crowd, hunting for any sign they are following her tempo, and sharpens her baton arms when they ignore it.
scenes.microexpression: Eyebrows shoot up on the downbeat, then lock into a stern conductor's frown.

scenes.location: Pedestrian crossing at a busy junction, grey city street, kerb on the near side of the road, signal pole behind her
scenes.action: On AND she freezes, arms raised, and the signal behind her flips from red standing figure to green walking figure exactly on its own timer. She detonates the Tempo Stomp: two stomps of her white trainers, a hip swing, one whistle blast, both fists thrust to the sky. The blurred crowd begins crossing without looking at her.
scenes.performance: Invested task: claim the change of light as her own work; she holds the instant of the flip with total certainty, then spends every limb on the celebration to sell that she caused it.
scenes.microexpression: Gap-toothed grin explodes wide, eyebrows lifting skyward with the fists.

scenes.location: Pedestrian crossing at a busy junction, grey city street, kerb on the near side of the road, signal pole behind her
scenes.action: Fists still in the air, Captain Tempo holds her frozen victory pose, beaming, whistle in her teeth. A single blurred commuter in a dark coat walks calmly through the frame between her raised fists and the camera, hair-width from her, never looking over. The camera lingers one beat too long on her unblinking triumphant face, then rests, still held.
scenes.performance: Invested task: soak up the applause nobody is giving; she scans the crowd for acknowledgement, finds none, and refuses to drop the pose.
scenes.microexpression: Proud grin holds, one eyebrow twitches up as the commuter passes, eyes stay locked on camera.
